text: Started on the tracker multi-agent view. Reading tracker.html and agents.json.

Tracker now reads .tracker/agents.json: registry colour and "model · number" name beat the name hash, and the per-agent .jsonl feeds merge into the one strip. Unregistered owners like @claude still render on the hashed colour.

Verified in Chromium on 4220: the strip shows all five registered agents by model, number and goal in their own colour, the four in-progress cards match their owner chip and border, and a routed tracker-feed.json line lands between two of my .jsonl lines in time order. A truncated last line loses only itself, and a 404 on agents.json falls back to the old hashed colours with no console error.
